title: Phrase Without a Word · Teams
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Phrase Without a Word · Teams with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose an everyday situation and one common word associated with it. The lead describes the situation without using the forbidden word. The others identify the situation and the clue avoids the forbidden word. Form two teams. Each team has four turns; only the lead’s teammates respond or assist. Each success earns the team one point. The higher team score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Phrase Without a Word, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The others identify the situation and the clue avoids the forbidden word.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The others identify the situation and the clue avoids the forbidden word.
